output.summary: A genus of cacti found in Mexico, Central America, the Caribbean and northern South America. They climb or grow on trees, rocks or the ground, producing aerial roots and large flowers that open at night. Several species produce edible pitaya or dragon fruit, gathered from the wild or cultivated.
output.edibilityNote: Fruits of several species are eaten; some are gathered wild, while others are cultivated as pitaya or dragon fruit.
